CustomField.description: Profile Complete for the EneOil loyalty program.
CustomField.formula: AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Make__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Vehicle_Fuel_Type__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Year__c)), Vehicle_Year__c >= 1900, Vehicle_Year__c <= YEAR(TODAY()) + 1)
CustomField.label: Profile Complete
